parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The function description to filter by.

parameters.name: fcVersion
parameters.description:
The version to which the function belongs. Valid values:

- v3: lists only FC 3.0 functions.
- v2: lists only FC 2.0 functions.

If not specified, both FC 3.0 and FC 2.0 functions are listed.

parameters.name: gpuType
parameters.description: The function GPU type to filter by.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of functions to return. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: runtime
parameters.description: The function runtime to filter by.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: The function tags to filter by.
